summary: Frontend testing of BookingConfirmation component across DiaGyn, Mango, and Pharmacy modules. DiaGyn booking flow verified successfully - BookingConfirmation shows correctly with 4-step flowchart (Arrive Early, Show ID, Wait, Consultation). Mango and Pharmacy flows tested up to form filling/OTP verification step. Component correctly renders different flows based on type and paymentMethod props.

BookingConfirmation_DiaGyn.details: Component renders with pink gradient header, 'Appointment Booked!' title, 'NEXT STEPS' flowchart with 4 steps: Arrive 10 Min Early, Show Booking ID, Wait for Turn, Consultation. data-testid='track-order-btn' present for View Appointment button.

BookingConfirmation_Mango_HomeCollection.details: Component correctly configured with steps: Confirm Timing, Home Collection, Sample Processing, Reports Ready. Integration verified in code (Mango.js lines 1129-1145). OTP verification required for complete end-to-end test.

BookingConfirmation_Mango_LabVisit.details: Component correctly configured with steps: Visit Lab, Sample Given, Make Payment, Reports Ready. collectionMode='lab' triggers lab visit flow.

BookingConfirmation_Pharmacy_COD.details: Component correctly configured with steps: Pharmacist Call, Order Packed, Out for Delivery, Pay on Delivery. paymentMethod='cod' triggers COD flow.

BookingConfirmation_Pharmacy_PayLater.details: Component correctly configured with steps: Pharmacist Call, Order Packed, Make Payment, Dispatch. paymentMethod='pay_later' triggers Pay Later flow.

DiaGyn_Booking_Flow.details: Complete booking flow tested: Doctor selection -> Clinic selection -> Date/Time selection -> Patient details -> Confirm booking. BookingConfirmation component displays after successful booking.

Mango_Booking_Flow.details: Flow tested up to OTP verification step. Cart addition, form filling, collection type selection (Home/Lab Visit) all working. OTP verification required for complete test.

Pharmacy_Booking_Flow.details: Flow tested up to cart addition. Medicine catalog displays correctly (4,315 items), Add to Cart works, cart shows items. Complete checkout requires payment flow.

context_for_next_testing_agent: BookingConfirmation component is properly integrated in all three modules. DiaGyn full flow verified. Mango and Pharmacy partial testing completed due to OTP/payment requirements. Component code is well-structured with clear separation of flows based on props.
